details:
This update for hauler fixes the following issues:

Changes in hauler:

- update to 2.1.1:
  * bumped go version to v1.26.7 (backport #771)
  * https registry auth fix (backport #763)
  * adjust supporting artifact retrieval (backport #777)
  * reject --platform on digest-pinned multi-platform images
  * fix: serve registry returns an empty /v2/_catalog list
  * added airgapped support for install.sh and added windows
    install.ps1
  * added/fixed basic auth with registry and fileserver
  * fixed store inventory race with concurrent processes
  * added type filter to store copy
  * fixed missing dirs in containers
  * updated github workflows with versions, permissions, and
    concurrency

- update vendor.tar to fix:
  * bsc#1280110, CVE-2026-53495
